reviews.title: Amazing GPU
reviews.comment: After having for 1 year, i can say this is a beast for whatever you throw at it. for $1000, you can get top tier performance. I use it for Workbench/Gaming, and it works exceptionally at both. Heavily recommend.

reviews.title: Everything worked!
reviews.comment: The item arrived faster than expected. It came with full packaging. I was very skeptical at first since it was the cheapest 4080 founders edition I could find, but I took a look at the Sellers’s eBay page and seen the same listing soon as I purchase that listing went down and they shipped my item from Amazon. I seen people say some things didn’t work, but I thought it might have been user error. They obviously offered returns so I took the gamble. Everything worked out perfectly. I would recommend this seller.
reviews.author: Virtue
